instruction: Pick the handheld round blue cup and position it on the light gray coaster

source.instruction: Pick the handheld round blue cup and position it on the light gray coaster

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the cup, which was at x = +26 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Partially close right gripper to prepare for grasping the rim of the cup.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the cup; closed the gripper (opening 0.51: holding the cup)

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.51; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient right gripper downward and align directly above the rim of the cup at (30.5, -17, 92.5).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +2, -1) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -17, 93) opening 0.48; table z = 74
frames.plan: Descend right gripper to z=82.5 around the rim and grasp it firmly.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the cup; closed the gripper (opening 0.07: holding the cup)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -17, 82) opening 0.07; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the cup up to z=90 to clear the table.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +8) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -17, 90) opening 0.07; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the cup over the coaster to roughly (13, -12, 87).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-17, +5, -3) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (13, -13, 87) opening 0.07; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower cup onto the coaster to z=84 and release gripper.
